newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -11 Sept 15 wk.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -11 Sept 15 wk.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News consumer comfort index rose to -11 in the week ended September 15 from -12 the week before.
"The greatest showing of current economic optimism in six and a half years put overall consumer confidence back on its late-summer plateau," according to a report released with the survey.

The survey, this time with 1,045 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Forty-two percent of consumers polled rated the economy positively, raising the survey's economic index -16 from -20 the week before.

Fifty-five percent, down two percentage points from last week's survey, gave good grades to their finances, holding the survey's "personal finances" index at 10. Thirty-seven percent said now is a good time to spend.
